method: Fixed dt=3 in the private research context. Edge runs the actual Canvas UnitsLayer and WebGL EntityLayer through the isolated page. The browser seals each sample at the first timer callback after the requested interval. Input time starts at the trusted DOM event timestamp. Local feedback ends at the first completed render callback and authority ends at receipt delivery.

repeatDefinition: Three independent trials per renderer under the same Edge build and original checkpoint.
measurementLimits: Timings measure active JavaScript wall time. Waits between slices are excluded from active work.
rAF records callback cadence. Browser and compositor wait attribution remains unresolved.
C uses smaller isolated scenes, a mortal-only natural checkpoint and fixed dt. A/B official-game results give context.
Input is eight trusted DOM clicks per trial. The local endpoint is the completed render callback. The authoritative endpoint is the delivered receipt.
Serialized DTO size counts one copy of each terrain layer. Explicit save and JSON DTO sizes exclude compression. Heap captures follow explicit GC outside the timed window.

separateCpuProfiles.note: Separate profiled trials. Sample self-hit counts describe captured stacks.

promotion: STOP. Command latency and atomic work exceed the planning thresholds. Canvas falls short of throughput. Product isolation and L2 fixed dt still require other approvals.
